description: Master index for specs/literature/ content. Used by literature-retrieve.sh for --lit injection into agent prompts. All entries are keyword-indexed for selective retrieval. PDFs in this directory are kept as source documents but have no index entries and are never injected.

schema.bib_key: BibTeX key in references.bib (null if not yet added)
schema.title: Full title of work
schema.section: Section or chapter description (null for whole-paper files)
schema.page_range: Page range within original source (null if unknown)

entries.title: Modal Logic (2002 Cambridge edition)
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Full text of Blackburn, de Rijke & Venema's Modal Logic (Cambridge 2002); covers Kripke semantics, bisimulation, correspondence theory, completeness, and general frames. NOTE: 365k tokens — will almost always exceed budget; prefer more specific entries.

entries.title: Axioms for Tense Logic. I. "Since" and "Until"
entries.summary: Axiomatizes the Until-Since tense logic for arbitrary linear orders, dense orders, and discrete orders using maximal consistent set constructions; foundational BX reference.

entries.title: Axioms for Tense Logic. II. Time Periods
entries.summary: Axiomatizes period-based tense logic for dense linear orders (rationals and reals), introducing the chronicle construction used in BX canonical model construction.

entries.title: Basic Tense Logic
entries.summary: Comprehensive handbook chapter on basic tense logic: semantics of F/P/G/H/U/S operators, axiom systems for linear/dense/discrete orders, and canonical model completeness methodology.

entries.title: On the Mosaic Method for Many-Dimensional Modal Logics
entries.authors: Carlos Caleiro, Luca Viganò, Marco Volpe
entries.summary: Proves completeness and decidability for S5 combined with linear tense logic using mosaic methods; directly covers the BX logical combination and offers a tableau system as alternative to canonical model completeness.

entries.title: Sahlqvist's Theorem for Boolean Algebras with Operators with an Application to Cylindric Algebras
entries.summary: Extends Sahlqvist correspondence theory to Boolean algebras with operators, applicable to polymodal and binary (Since/Until) modal operators.

entries.title: Completeness and Definability: Applications of the Ehrenfeucht Game in Second-Order and Intensional Logic
entries.summary: Doctoral dissertation applying Ehrenfeucht games to completeness and definability questions in second-order and intensional logic; background for Doets's key lemma on well-ordered linear models.

entries.title: Monadic Pi-1-1 Theories of Pi-1-1-Properties
entries.summary: Theorem 3.8 (definably well-ordered linear models have well-ordered n-equivalents) is the key technical lemma enabling Venema 1993's model-replacement technique and Reynolds 1992's rational-to-real transfer.

entries.title: Temporal Expressive Completeness in the Presence of Gaps
entries.authors: Dov Gabbay, Ian Hodkinson, Mark Reynolds
entries.summary: Expressive completeness for {S,U} temporal logic in the presence of gaps in linear orders; cited as reference [5] in Reynolds's Theorem 14 gap elimination proof.

entries.title: Temporal Logic: Mathematical Foundations — Chapter 9: Separation and Temporal Logic
entries.authors: Dov Gabbay, Ian Hodkinson, Mark Reynolds
entries.summary: Chapter 9 of GHR94 Vol. 1: introduces the separation property framework for establishing expressive completeness of {S,U} temporal logic over linear orders.

entries.title: Temporal Logic: Mathematical Foundations — Chapter 10: Temporal Logic over the Integers
entries.authors: Dov Gabbay, Ian Hodkinson, Mark Reynolds
entries.section: Chapter 10: Temporal Logic over the Integers
entries.summary: Chapter 10 of GHR94: Separation Theorem for temporal logic over integers (Theorem 10.2.9) and completeness proof for the Until-Since tense logic over ℤ; basis for the BX separation proof.

entries.title: Temporal Logic: Mathematical Foundations — Chapter 12: Expressive Completeness
entries.authors: Dov Gabbay, Ian Hodkinson, Mark Reynolds
entries.summary: Chapter 12 of GHR94 Vol. 1: expressive completeness results for {S,U} over various linear order types including orders with gaps; extends the separation framework from Chapters 9-10.

entries.title: Erdős Graphs Resolve Fine's Canonicity Problem
entries.authors: Robert Goldblatt, Ian Hodkinson, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Shows 2^ℵ₀ BAO varieties are not generated by complex algebras of any first-order definable class; important negative result for algebraic representation theory relevant to S/U operators.

entries.title: Temporal Logic (Handbook of Modal Logic, Chapter 11)
entries.summary: Modern survey of temporal logic (table of contents and introduction only; full chapter truncated); covers axiomatizations, completeness, filtration, and finite model property.

entries.title: Elements of Finite Model Theory — Chapters 3 and 7: EF Games and MSO Composition
entries.summary: Chapters 3 and 7 of Libkin's finite model theory textbook: EF games and composition lemma for linear orders (Lemma 3.7), MSO composition (Lemma 7.11), Büchi's theorem and McNaughton-Papert via composition.

entries.title: Lean Formalization of Completeness Proof for Coalition Logic with Common Knowledge
entries.authors: Kristóf Obendrauf, Anne Baanen, Patrick Koopmann, Vera Stebletsova
entries.summary: ~6,000-line Lean 4 canonical model completeness proof for coalition logic with common knowledge; directly transferable patterns for type class generalization and Lindenbaum construction.

entries.title: A Proof of Kamp's Theorem
entries.summary: Clean proof of Kamp's theorem (TL(Until,Since) = FOMLO over Dedekind complete chains) using composition rather than EF games; Section 5 shows interval splitting when a new point is inserted — directly applicable to BX gap analysis.

entries.title: An Axiomatization for Until and Since over the Reals without the IRR Rule
entries.summary: Proves completeness for Until-Since tense logic over the reals using orthodox inference rules only (no IRR rule), via Doets's theorem to transfer from rational to real flows; directly relevant to BX chain construction.

entries.title: Axiomatising First-Order Temporal Logic: Until and Since over Linear Time
entries.summary: Sound and complete axiom system for first-order temporal logic with Until and Since over linear orders; the canonical MCS construction parallels BX's chronicle-based completeness proof.

entries.title: An Axiomatization of Full Computation Tree Logic
entries.summary: Axiomatizes full CTL* (branching-time temporal logic); rule-based canonical model technique may offer structural insights for BX even though CTL* is branching-time rather than linear.

entries.title: Ehrenfeucht-Fraïssé Games, the Composition Method, and the Monadic Theory of Ordinal Words
entries.summary: Survey connecting automata, EF games, and the composition method for monadic logic on ordinal words; extends Büchi MSO=regular to transfinite words. NOTE: MD summary reconstructed from secondary sources; no PDF obtained (Springer paywall).

entries.title: Combinations of Tense and Modality
entries.summary: Standard handbook reference for combining tense logic with modal logic; covers interaction axioms, frame conditions, and completeness for tense-modal combinations analogous to BX.

entries.title: Many-Dimensional Modal Logics — Chapter 2
entries.summary: Chapter 2 of Venema's dissertation on many-dimensional modal logics: foundational algebraic treatment of polymodal BAOs including binary temporal operators.

entries.title: Many-Dimensional Modal Logics — Appendices A and B
entries.summary: Appendices A and B of Venema's dissertation on many-dimensional modal logics; contains supplementary technical results for the algebraic representation theory.

entries.title: Derivation Rules as Anti-Axioms in Modal Logic
entries.summary: Key paper connecting orthodox axiomatizability to BAO representation: orthodox systems ensure closure under ultraproducts; non-orthodox (IRR-using) systems break this; explains why orthodox BX axiomatization is algebraically well-behaved.

entries.title: Since and Until
entries.summary: Extends Burgess/Xu to strict and discrete time using 'completeness via completeness'; explains three intertwined senses of completeness for U,S logics; directly relevant to BX's irreflexive temporal ordering.

entries.title: Atom Structures and Sahlqvist Equations
entries.summary: Studies atom-canonicity of BAO varieties and when Sahlqvist equations define them; S/U representation depends on canonical extensions being well-behaved.

entries.title: Temporal Logic
entries.summary: Survey covering basic tense logic (G/H/F/P), Since/Until extension, Kamp's expressive completeness theorem, branching time, and interval logic; confirms U(φ,ψ) convention: φ=event at witness, ψ=guard at intermediates.

entries.title: Completeness by Construction for Tense Logics of Linear Time
entries.authors: Dick de Jongh, Frank Veltman, Rineke Verbrugge
entries.summary: Constructive step-by-step method: builds models by inserting witnesses into a growing linear order rather than extending a fixed chain; directly applicable to the BX F-propagation and gap problems.

entries.title: On Some U,S-Tense Logics
entries.summary: The 'X' in BX: extends Burgess's completeness methods to non-linear (branching) time and establishes that irreflexivity is not U,S-definable; foundational for the BX axiom system formalized in this project.
